rules: Only entries explicitly marked converted or retained have a disposition under this ticket.
Historical XML formulas and closed research issues are inputs, not reviewed dispositions.
Owner candidates must be split into separately indexed logical fields; aliases share one entry.

User-authorized switch/case conversion is valid when a table clearly represents fixed case selection or dispatch; preserve domain, compatibility exceptions and one independent proof per logical table.
Discover through source and call graphs only. Do not run research suites or gameplay to choose work.
No repository-wide completion claim: unlisted tables are unreviewed, not excluded.

tables.domain: ushort health 0..6000; native eight unsigned little-endian thresholds selected by even byte offsets 0..14
tables.interpretation: First nonnegative signed 16-bit health-minus-threshold difference. Differences cannot overflow in supported health range. Adjacent $FFFF at $A5:96FF is unreachable.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_A5.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL loop; complete production selector compared with original cartridge threshold scan for all 6001 health inputs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array and search; return 2*max(0,7-health/750) after preserving maximum-health validation.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 750 explain every threshold. Integer quotient directly expresses health bands; no floating point, fitting, interpolation or exceptional corrections needed. Exact multiples belong to higher band.
tables.proofTest: VerifyDraygonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.domain: even ushort phase byte offsets 0..14 and all ushort health values 0..65535
tables.interpretation: Threshold words are unsigned little-endian. Subtraction wraps to 16 bits then tests sign. Offset 16 is caller-owned completion; odd or later offsets are rejected.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_B3.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL/completion flow; complete production result compared with original cartridge thresholds for all 524288 phase/health pairs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array; compute 375*(8-phaseByteOffset/2) after offset validation and retain signed wrapped subtraction.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 375 exactly explain the threshold domain. A direct unsigned health comparison would change supported wrap behavior; formula changes only the selected threshold.
tables.proofTest: VerifyBotwoonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.nativeIdentity: $A8:CCC9+10*i timer field of palette records; $A8:CC67 graphics hook
tables.domain: ushort byte offsets 0,10,20,30,40,50; normalization additionally accepts terminator offset 60
tables.interpretation: Six unsigned little-endian duration words interleaved with four color words. Native cursor advances ten bytes. Negative color word at $A8:CCFD resets cursor before reading the next timer.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all six bank_A8.asm records and native timer/advance/reset flow; compare every production duration to cartridge, verify terminator, rejected offsets and 193-call production cadence.
tables.disposition: Remove duration array; return record%3==0 ? 64 : 16 after existing alignment/range validation.
tables.rationale: Two exact repetitions of a three-record timing policy. Bounded modulo clearly names cadence and does not admit invalid inputs. Colors are separately owned presentation data, not covered by this disposition.
tables.proofTest: VerifyWorkRobotPaletteTimingDefinitions (existing test reused; duration rejection assertions extended)

consumers: RoomEnemySystem.Botwoon initialization, UpdateBotwoonHealthPhase and spit setup
tables.domain: byte phase 0..2; two copies of the same unsigned little-endian speed policy
tables.interpretation: Native offsets are 4*p for movement and 2*p for spit. Caller retains zero-health phase zero and hidden-phase hold behavior.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read complete NTSC/PAL table branches and native consumers at $B3:95EE,9996,9F04,9F51; compare actual API to all six NTSC cartridge speed words and 3001 production health transitions.
tables.disposition: Replace three-record switch with phase+2, shared by movement and spit after bounds validation.
tables.rationale: Exact step-one arithmetic progression, no rounding or fitting. PAL movement has a different contract and is not admitted by this NTSC API.
tables.proofTest: VerifyBotwoonSpeedAlgorithm (existing test split by logical field)

tables.domain: byte phase 0..2; separately indexed unsigned spacing word
tables.interpretation: Body-history spacing selected by the same phase as speed; retain phase rejection and NTSC interpretation.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all three native NTSC spacings and independent disassembly annotation 0x30/speed. Compare actual API to all three original cartridge words.
tables.disposition: Compute 48/(phase+2) after shared bounds validation.
tables.rationale: 48 is divisible by all supported speeds (2,3,4); integer division expresses exact inverse travel time without rounding or exceptions.
tables.proofTest: VerifyBotwoonSpacingAlgorithm (split from existing speed test)

tables.domain: int beamIndex 0..11; twelve unsigned little-endian words
tables.interpretation: Caller masks equipment to low nibble and rejects 12..15; API takes undoubled index. Zero beam has zero cost. Only the four single-beam selections cost one.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all twelve native words and FireSBA mask/ASL/subtraction at $90:CCCD..CCDE; compare actual API against complete cartridge table.
tables.disposition: Remove cost array; validated nonzero power-of-two predicate returns one, otherwise zero.
tables.rationale: Equipment bits establish a semantic single-beam predicate, not an incidental sequence fit. Unsupported combinations remain rejected.
tables.proofTest: VerifyComboPowerBombCostAlgorithm (extracted from existing combined verifier)

tables.domain: int projectileSlot 0..3; unsigned angles with 256 units per turn
tables.interpretation: Native Ice/Plasma loops select byte offsets 6,4,2,0. Caller supplies slots 3,2,1,0. Four adjacent unused diagonal angles do not extend domain.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read native angle region and consumers at $90:CDC8/CEBA; compare actual API to all four reachable original cartridge words.
tables.disposition: Remove angle array; return 64*projectileSlot after bounds validation.
tables.rationale: Exact quarter-turn spacing in native angular units; no wrap, truncation or interpolation within bounded domain.
tables.proofTest: VerifyComboOriginAngleAlgorithm (extracted from existing combined verifier)

tables.domain: int sprite slot 28..31, native byte offsets 0,2,4,6
tables.interpretation: Signed little-endian stream-byte latency added with ushort wrap before signed test. First four entries retain native initial 128 inert frames.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight words and $A5:A13E loop (X=0x3E down to 0x38, Y=X-0x38); compare actual API to all four reachable original signed cartridge words.
tables.disposition: Remove latency array; return 128*(slot-35) after validating slots.
tables.rationale: Exact linear progression in stream-byte units. Following unused words do not extend domain. Packed trajectory is a separate unreviewed logical table.
tables.proofTest: VerifyDraygonIntroLatencyDefinitions (existing proof reused)

tables.domain: int selector 0..3; native little-endian word at base+2*selector; caller sanitizes negative or >=4 to zero
tables.interpretation: Neutral/left/right list selection for 0..2; selector 3 observes the first opcode word of adjacent code, not a fourth authored list.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read full native initialization and named targets in pinned bank_A8.asm; all eight bytes independently read from SHA-256-identified NTSC ROM. Existing proof extracted and compared every production result and real initializer with original cartridge words.
tables.disposition: Remove pointer array; explicit named switch cases including the bounded opcode-overread case.
tables.rationale: Clear case-selection semantics under user's switch permission. Arithmetic six-byte stride would obscure symbolic choices and couple selection to list storage layout; selector 3 must not extrapolate it.
tables.proofTest: VerifyWorkRobotInitialSelection (extracted from existing combined selector verifier)

tables.domain: ushort byteOffset 0..16 inclusive; all complete four-byte windows in twenty-byte definition, including unaligned and cross-record views
tables.interpretation: High word then fractional word, each little-endian, assembled into signed 16.16; caller applies direction by addition/subtraction. Trailing zero record remains readable.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all native NTSC/PAL words and $A3:B4E0/B4FD consumers, plus compiled caller and byte-window implementation. Independently read all twenty NTSC ROM bytes; they match the compiled ten words.
tables.disposition: Retain compact word table and exact byte-window accessor.
tables.rationale: Authored speeds 0,1/2,5/8,2,0 lack constant first/second differences or geometric ratios. A piecewise numerical formula merely restates choices. Unlike a discrete phase dispatcher, public reads include every unaligned byte window; a phase switch would lose that contract and a per-window switch would obscure the original five records.
tables.proofTest: No new test for retain decision; existing Zoa checks retained.

owtchShakeReview.evidence: Independent NTSC J/U v1.0 cartridge words (SHA-256 checked by focused command), pinned bank_A2/A0/86.asm definitions and native/current consumer indexing. No gameplay discovery.

tables.interpretation: Parameter two high byte selects an undoubled index; native doubles for word lookup and adds/subtracts distance with ushort wrap.
tables.disposition: Remove eight-word array; return 16*(index+1) after bounds validation.
tables.rationale: Exact constant difference of sixteen covers all eight authored patrol half-widths; no rounding or exceptions.
tables.proofTest: VerifyOwtchTravelDistanceAlgorithm, extracted from existing verifier; all original words and invalid bounds

tables.domain: byte selector 0..5; unsigned little-endian duration words
tables.interpretation: Parameter one high byte selects duration; NTSC !FPS=1. Independent shorter bound than travel distance.
tables.disposition: Remove six-word array; return 32*(index+1) after bounds validation.
tables.rationale: Pinned assembly explicitly expresses this multiplication series; integer NTSC duration with no rounding. PAL is not admitted by this contract.
tables.proofTest: VerifyOwtchUndergroundTimerAlgorithm, extracted from existing verifier; all original words and invalid bounds

tables.domain: ushort type 0..35; paired signed X/Y words, native positive magnitudes 0..3
tables.interpretation: group=type/9, strength=(type/3)%3+1, direction=type%3 (horizontal,vertical,diagonal). Caller retains timer-bit sign alternation and lifetime.
tables.disposition: Generate direction vector and enable BG1 except group 3.
tables.rationale: Native table annotations and complete words identify Cartesian product of recipient, strength and direction; no fitted curve or input wrapping.
tables.proofTest: VerifyRoomShakeBg1Algorithm, all 36 original vectors and bounds

tables.domain: ushort type 0..35; paired signed X/Y words, positive magnitudes 0..3
tables.interpretation: Same geometric direction/strength policy, separately selected BG2 recipient; sign remains caller-owned.
tables.disposition: Generate direction vector and enable BG2 except group 0.
tables.rationale: Recipient differs from BG1 despite adjacent storage, so separately reviewed; complete native words support exact shared geometry.
tables.proofTest: VerifyRoomShakeBg2Algorithm, all 36 original vectors and bounds

tables.domain: ushort type 0..35; paired signed X/Y words, positive magnitudes 0..3
tables.interpretation: Projectile draw receives same geometric vector only in groups 2/3; timer sign and frozen/disabled checks remain caller-owned. Type 36+ rejected by API, ignored by caller.
tables.disposition: Generate direction vector and enable projectile displacement for group>=2.
tables.rationale: Original table explicitly separates two zero-recipient groups from two moving groups. Preserve exact type bound before modulo, without aliases or overreads.
tables.proofTest: VerifyRoomShakeProjectileAlgorithm, all 36 original vectors and bounds

tables.domain: shape 0..31, column 0..15; each axis independently bounded
tables.interpretation: Top Y height indexed by X despite swapped native label. Values 0..20 fit original five-bit mask. Caller owns BTS mirroring, floor/ceiling orientation and coordinate wrap.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all 32 profiles and shape annotations in pinned bank_94.asm and every production index construction. Compare actual Read with all 512 original NTSC ROM bytes (same five-bit interpretation) in the existing proof.
tables.disposition: Remove samples; bounded shape switch evaluates flat, half-block, V, stair, rational and steep profiles with integer arithmetic.
tables.rationale: Native geometry explains repeated samples and cross-tile phase. Nonnegative division floors; third-height slopes preserve phase across seams. Steep heights above 16 encode as 20 rather than numeric saturation; shape 17 explicitly retains authored overhang. No fitted corrections or platform math.
tables.proofTest: VerifyCompiledSlopeHeights (existing proof reused, bounds extended); includes 12288 mirrored Samus samples and 55296 direct cross-consumer collision/alignment cases

tables.domain: flattened index 0..19 (4*shape+quadrant); invalid indices keep IndexOutOfRangeException from prior span indexing
tables.interpretation: Quadrants 0..3 are top-left/right/bottom-left/right; exact bytes 0 or 128. Caller retains XOR mirroring and leading-edge selection.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all native shape/quadrant definitions and caller transformations in pinned bank_94.asm/current source. Compare all twenty production results with original cartridge bytes.
tables.disposition: Replace stored span with ReadSamusQuadrant: bottom, right, bottom-and-right, bottom-or-right, or full solidity by shape.
tables.rationale: Boolean geometry directly expresses the five independently named native shapes without four repeated samples per shape. Validate before extracting bits; no input wrapping.
tables.proofTest: VerifySamusSquareSlopeAlgorithm (split from existing combined proof); includes 10240 real mirrored missile points in both axes and invalid bounds

tables.domain: flattened index 0..19; same invalid-index exception as previous span
tables.interpretation: Same Boolean geometry as Samus but low two bits retain quadrant identity. Complete original byte preserved, not only bit-seven solidity.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read complete pinned bank_A0/bank_86 tables; all forty original cartridge bytes compare with actual algorithm. Source migration preserves every tableIndex/XOR transform.
tables.disposition: Remove stored span; validated Samus solidity OR quadrant identity.
tables.rationale: Two physical copies are one logical policy. Shared geometry plus identity bits explains every result without invented exceptions.
tables.proofTest: VerifyEnemySquareSlopeAlgorithm (split from existing combined proof), all bytes in both copies plus invalid bounds

tables.disposition: Retain seven directly readable initial posture words; all original words independently checked in the Shaktool proof.
tables.rationale: Exact candidate is -2048*t modulo 65536, t=i*(i+1)/2 for i<=4 else 16-(7-i)*(8-i)/2. This reflected triangular construction fits the entire bounded set but introduces a bend pivot/reflection policy for seven authored angles. It is not evidence of the historical generator and is less transparent than this short posture table. No unbounded fitting needed.

tables.disposition: Retain seven authored curl rates; ShaktoolAngularVelocityDefinitions is an alias, not another table.
tables.rationale: Rates equal 32*t for the reflected triangular candidate above; initial angles equal -64*rate with word wrap. Combining these independent initial-pose and reset-rate policies through that curve saves few words while obscuring explicit tuning. Complete values and initialization/reset consumers independently inspected; existing focused original-word proof passed in bb8ba856.

tables.disposition: Already converted: compiled initialization omits subtraction of zero; no new runtime change.
tables.rationale: All seven original unsigned subtrahends are zero; native SBC at $AA:DE76 therefore leaves the selected angular word unchanged. Confirmed source and all original words in existing Shaktool proof. No rounding or overflow difference is possible.
